what: Build tickets were marked done with only their own tests passing: typecheck and lint were never run, so type errors and lint failures piled up until the owner ran them by hand
rule: Every build ticket must pass the project typecheck and lint (and build when cheap) before it is done; a failure goes back to the worker with the errors.
fix: run typecheck and lint as merge-batch checks for every build ticket and keep the ticket in review until they passed
